notes.title: Unravel 2 announced, available now
notes.content:
Charming yarn-based puzzle platformer Unravel is getting a sequel, perhaps unsurprisingly named Unravel 2. More surprisingly, though, it is available today.

You can now play with either one or two players, with the second person controlling a new blue Yarny character.

Unravel's creator - the lovely Martin Sahlen, who memorably revealed the original Unravel on stage at E3 a couple of years ago - showed off a small demo of the game during EA's press conference. Using the familiar swinging rope gameplay, we saw Martin and an accomplice swing their to safety from a rampaging chicken.
